gnosh mcp list

  List the servers this folder uses, and whether each connects. A project's
  servers in a folder that is not trusted are named and not started.
  Also typed: gnosh mcp ls.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp list [flags]

Flags
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
